detail.longDescription: I have a program of which I wish to make a toolbox to keep track of the scripts, file models, images it creates and uses, to keep backups in case I mess up with something and that breaks everything (basically I need version control), but the program's distributed through many many many different folders in my machine, so to keep check of everything I've decided to use git for the version control. Is it possible/reasonable to make a git project out of the root an already existing and running Windows Server machine?
